longDescription: A twin-map toolkit for product designers. The story map turns a raw requirement into seven fields, splits the solution into a journey backbone, and grounds each feature in Who/What/When/Why/DoD with MoSCoW priorities and release swimlanes. The journey map captures a persona-by-scenario experience per stage: actions, touchpoints, thoughts, emotion, pain points and opportunities, with fact/hypothesis labels, an emotional curve and moments of truth. Journey-map opportunities import as story-map feature drafts. State lives in one JSON file, applied atomically by scripts and re-renderable anytime.
tryPrompts: Map out a raw requirement into a user story map
Analyze this persona's user journey in this scenario
Import journey-map opportunities into the story map
